staff_fields.target_selection_phase_skill: 0x20; signed byte, semantic label not assigned here

cleanliness_metric.formula: min(100, trunc_toward_zero(sum(assigned staff cleaning skill)*100 / denominator[level]))
cleanliness_metric.includes: All3 assigned refs except-1; this score function does not filter by task, rest or energy.

visual_floor.stain_variants: base+1..base+4 are alternative patterns selected by one rand()%4; not progressive dirt levels

stain_update.condition: staff-derived summary+4 < current visual floor percentage
stain_update.target: First active customer in slots0..19 whose floor cell has code0..15 and remainder0 mod5.
stain_update.coordinate: signed customer x/y divided by2 with truncation toward zero
stain_update.write: base=trunc(tile/5)*5; tile=base+rand()%4+1; dirty cache byte+1=0; stop after one successful stain.
stain_update.counter: If pre-stain visual percentage<70, increment store+12e4 modulo256; independent of whether a new stain was added.

cleaning_target.mark: Mark accessible half-cells in each dirty full floor tile as10001; reservations can exclude another cleaner target.

clean_action.random_gate: First rand()%5 must equal0; then another rand()%100+1 must be<=cleaning_skill.
clean_action.on_success: Parent sets sound flag0x800, clears staff target and applies cleaning skill growth.

advice.threshold: signed dirty counter>=4, then rand()%100+1<=manager leadership byte1d
advice.resets: Counters12e1..12e4 reset at minute0 and hour divisible by4, or after advice; rare branch has additional resets.
advice.note: Threshold is not a count of dirty tiles and not an elapsed-hours field.

unconfirmed: A general fixture breakage/repair system has not been established by these floor/cleaning functions; do not add one from this report.
